name: settings
description: A six-tooth gear with flowing shoulders and a circular center.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Six original radial teeth use straight faces with individually rounded transitions. The recognizable gear is a silhouette exception to the rounded rectangle baseline. Opposite teeth are constructed in symmetric pairs about 12,12; the circular hub remains circular. Owner-approved source. The owner-selected 30-degree clockwise orientation is baked into all source coordinates about 12,12 for both styles. This orientation is now native rotation 0 degrees; no SVG or preview transform is needed. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Established centerline proportions and pose are retained. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved every current static icon, style and supported frame on 2026-10-27. Motion approval is separate.

reviewHistory.note: Owner approved Settings Outline and Filled at the previous 30-degree preview orientation. At the owner's request, that orientation is now baked into both original SVGs and is the native 0-degree baseline. Exterior and hub alignment are preserved at Regular 1.70.
